name: sudarshan
description: Sudarshan - a local-first job application agent that goes out, finishes the task, and returns. LinkedIn, Naukri and any career site; your own AI key or a free local model.

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/server && npm run test:browser -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
